text: 中国人民银行货币政策委员会2026年第三季度（总第114次）例会于9月19日召开。规范信贷市场经营行为，降低融资中间费用，促进社会综合融资成本低位运行。从宏观审慎的角度观察、评估债市运行情况，关注长期收益率的变化。畅通货币政策传导机制，提高资金使用效率。坚持市场在汇率形成中的决定性作用，增强外汇市场韧性，稳定市场预期，同时防范市场“羊群效应”和非理性预期的自我强化，保持人民币汇率在合理均衡水平上的基本稳定。
text_en: The third-quarter 2026 regular meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee of the People's Bank of China (114th meeting in total) was held on September 19. It is necessary to regulate business conduct in the credit market, reduce intermediary financing costs, and promote the comprehensive social financing cost at a low level. From a macro-prudential perspective, the operation of the bond market should be observed and assessed, with attention paid to changes in long-term yields. It is necessary to smooth the monetary policy transmission mechanism and improve the efficiency of fund use. The decisive role of the market in exchange rate formation should be upheld, the resilience of the foreign exchange market should be enhanced, market expectations should be stabilized, and at the same time the self-reinforcement of herd behavior and irrational expectations in the market should be prevented, so as to keep the RMB exchange rate basically stable at a reasonable and balanced level.
